'''Tarrek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he was stationed at [[Eyrie Base]].<ref name="J10" />
